prompt.en: who knew which was the real wukong?
prompt.zh: 谁知道哪个才是真的悟空？

answer_evidence.quote: "You look exactly alike. I can't tell who is who."
"I believe my pet beast, Curious Ear, can help," said the spirit.
"Curious Ear can tell the true from the false," said the spirit.
The beast stared hard at the two Wukongs.
"I know who the fake Sun Wukong is."

prompt.en: where did guanyin tell the wukongs to go?
prompt.zh: 观音告诉悟空们去哪里？

answer_evidence.quote: "I still don't know which of you is the real Wukong. You should both go to Heaven. The real Wukong used to live there. Maybe the Jade Emperor can tell who is who."

prompt.en: what did the jade emperor tell the wukongs to do?
prompt.zh: 玉皇大帝告诉悟空们做什么？

choices.en: go to the land of darkness

answer_evidence.quote: "Both of you, leave at once!" thundered the Jade Emperor.
"One Wukong is bad enough. I don't want two of you around. You can fight somewhere else!"
"Go to the Land of Darkness," said Venus.
"Maybe the Judge of the Dead can tell you apart."
